recipe_version.title: Greek Spanakopita Pan Pie with Cucumber-Tomato Salad
recipe_version.description: A golden, flaky pan pie of olive-oil-brushed phyllo layered around a spinach, feta, scallion, dill, and parsley filling with a hint of nutmeg, baked until shatteringly crisp. Served with a sharp cucumber, tomato, and oregano salad.

ingredients.name: phyllo dough
ingredients.display_name: sheets phyllo (about 1 lb), thawed overnight in the fridge

ingredients.name: olive oil
ingredients.note: 2 tbsp onions, about 1/2 cup brushing, 2 tbsp salad

steps.title: Preheat and prep
steps.body: Preheat the oven to 375 F. Squeeze the thawed spinach in a clean towel until very dry. Crumble the feta, slice the scallions, dice the onion, and chop the dill and parsley. Unroll the phyllo and keep it covered with a towel.

steps.title: Soften the onions
steps.body: Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in the skillet over medium and cook the onion and scallions until soft, 6 minutes. Cool briefly.

steps.title: Mix the filling
steps.body: Beat the eggs in the large bowl, then mix in the spinach, feta, onions, dill, parsley, nutmeg, pepper, and 1/4 tsp salt.

steps.title: Layer the pie
steps.body: Brush the pan with oil. Lay in 8 phyllo sheets, brushing each with oil and letting the excess hang over the sides. Spread the filling evenly, fold in the overhang, and top with the remaining 8 sheets, brushing each. Tuck the edges and score the top into 12 squares with a sharp knife.

steps.title: Bake
steps.body: Bake until deep golden and crisp, 45 minutes.

steps.title: Make the salad
steps.body: While the pie bakes, toss the cucumber and tomatoes with the vinegar, oregano, 2 tbsp olive oil, and 1/2 tsp salt (overlap stated).

steps.title: Rest and serve
steps.body: Rest the pie 10 minutes, cut along the scored lines, and serve with the salad.
